app_description: Group trip planning: a plan nobody feels they lost on.
account_auth_disabled_dev: Sign-in is turned off: set VITE_AUTH0_DOMAIN and VITE_AUTH0_CLIENT_ID in .env.local.
trips_tagline: Plans you put together as a group.
trips_login_required_title: Sign in to see your trips
trips_login_required_auth_disabled_dev: The API requires sign-in and Auth0 is not configured. Set VITE_AUTH0_* in .env.local.
trips_login_required_auth_disabled: Sign-in is temporarily unavailable, so we can't show your trips. Try again later.
trips_login_required_body: Trips belong to the organizer's account. You can sign in with Google or Discord.
trips_offline_body: Couldn't connect to the server. Check your internet connection or whether the backend is running.
trips_load_failed_body: The server returned an error. Try again in a moment.
trips_empty_title: Your first trip starts with a name
trips_empty_body: Say where and when you're going. The interview collects everyone's preferences afterwards, and the plan is built so nobody comes out worse.
trips_no_match_body: We search trip names and destinations.
trips_create_description: A name is enough to start. You'll fill in the rest during the interview.
trips_create_failed: Couldn't create the trip. Try again.
trip_form_destination_hint: You can leave it empty and decide later.
not_found_body: This address doesn't lead to any page. The link may be out of date.

trip_interview_body: Tell it in one sentence where you are going and with whom. The assistant asks about the rest.
trip_people_body_manage: Add people without an account here, such as a child or a grandmother, and invite the rest.
trip_people_body_member: See here who is coming and what they like.
trip_login_required_title: Sign in to see this trip
trip_not_found_body: This trip does not exist, or you do not have access to it.

plan_empty_body_member: The host has not built the plan yet. Once they do, you will see it here.
plan_recomputing_status: Recalculating the plan. You are seeing the previous version.
plan_compute_forbidden_body: The host or a co-host builds the plan.
plan_hash_hint: The same input gives the same hash.
plan_day_empty: Nothing planned for this day yet.
